findings.label: Pagination link generation security
findings.issue: When building the query string in use-project-filters.ts, filter values bypass URL parameter sanitization. If malicious input reaches this hook (via URL manipulation), params.set() will encode it, so reflected XSS is prevented by the URLSearchParams API, but stricter validation at the entry point would be safer.

findings.label: EmptyState accessibility
findings.issue: EmptyState renders a bare div with no ARIA landmark or role. If filters return zero results, screen readers won't know this is a 'no results' state vs a loading state. Add role='alert' and aria-live='assertive' to signal that nothing was found.

findings.label: CodeBlock dangerouslySetInnerHTML requires sanitization
findings.issue: The Shiki-highlighted output is trusted because Shiki generates safe HTML from the database (not user input), but the code doesn't document this assumption. Add a comment noting 'Shiki output is always safe from user input' to harden future maintenance.
